name: Vintage Mainframe
description: A vintage mainframe terminal has gone quiet, and its archive record is missing. Search the lab network at 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199. Recover the record from the machine you find.

tasks.name: Recover the archive record
tasks.description: The mainframe's archive record is missing. Search the lab network at 172.20.0.0/24, where challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199, and recover the record.
hints: Look closely at the responses from the open ports; the machines may have more to say than their numbers suggest.
Compare what each service says with the protocol normally associated with its port. Identify the protocol from its response.
One service speaks Redis. Use a Redis read command to retrieve the archive record.
